 * @param {string} ruleName The name of the rule.
 * @returns {() => import("../types").Rule.RuleModule} A function that loads the rule module.
 */
function createRuleLoader(ruleName) {
	return () => require(`./${ruleName}`);
}

 * Builds an entry object for a single rule.
 * @param {string} ruleName The name of the rule.
 * @returns {[string, () => import("../types").Rule.RuleModule]} A key-value pair for the rule.

	return [ruleName, createRuleLoader(ruleName)];
